scenarios.name: Severe Bear
scenarios.description: China structural decline; wholesale collapse; competitive pressure from Anta/Li-Ning

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.description: China weakness persists 3+ years; wholesale softness; DTC growth moderates

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.description: Execution on turnaround; China stabilizes and returns to +1-2% growth; margin recovery to normalized 45.5%; DTC to 30%

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.description: China recovers faster (+5% CAGR); DTC penetration accelerates to 35%; pricing power maintained; gross margin 46.5%

scenarios.name: Extreme Bull
scenarios.description: China growth strong (+8% CAGR); DTC 40%+ mix; product innovation exceeds expectations; international expansion (India, Vietnam) acceleration
